items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Santa Pecora... No? [INTERVIEWEE] No. You mentioned the name.

ctx.x: Nice relax? I like the relaxedness of the record.
I wanted to mention some of the members of the band and Oscar, yeah, okay, thanks, Oscar. Santa Pecora, Lester Bouchon, Raymond Burke. No?
